outcome: body mass index-for-age z scores at age 12 months
cohort: 727 infants (from a cohort of pregnant women aged 18 years or older with homogeneous parental ethnic background in their first trimester) in Singapore.
finding: Elective cesarean delivery, but not emergency cesarean delivery, was significantly associated with an increased risk of overweight or at risk of overweight at age 12 months.
birth_weight: Sex-adjusted birth weight-for-gestational age was used as a covariate.
